notes.title: Doodle Dimension Update
notes.content:
Major update coming soon-we are going to add a bunch of levels to the game with new enemies and a final boss battle. We are also adding the market where you can buy upgrades with doodle gems (earned in game)
What exactly will this update include-
1. 5-10 more levels
2. 10 purchasable variants for each tower
3. 2 new towers particle accelerator and lightning tower
4. a fresh set of new enemy's to face off against.
5. the final boss battle ending
